checksRun.check: Classic-BPF decode with an independent decoder (all 14; EFFECT_GATE in detail)
checksRun.result: PASS. The decoded tuples equal the compiler's. Each program starts with LD arch (k=4), then JEQ AUDIT_ARCH: x86_64 0xC000003E and aarch64 0xC00000B7, both computed independently from the uapi values. Then come RET KILL_PROCESS and LD nr. On x86_64 the header continues with JGE 0x40000000 and RET KILL_PROCESS, which refuses x32. Every program ends with RET KILL_PROCESS. Every jump stays in range, only the compiler's opcodes appear, RET values are only ALLOW, KILL_PROCESS or ERRNO, and every load is aligned and inside seccomp_data. EFFECT_GATE has 183 instructions on aarch64 and 194 on x86_64.
